title: Local section comparison of a short complex from first-cohomology vanishing
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $V\subseteq Y$ an open, and $S=(M_1\xrightarrow f M_2\xrightarrow g M_3)$ a short complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules, so $gf=0$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $U$ forget the sheaf condition, $L$ be exact sheafification, and $\epsilon:LU\to\mathrm{id}$ their adjunction counit. Homology means $\ker g/\operatorname{im}f$. Suppose $H^1(V,(\ker f)|_V)=0$ and $H^1(V,(\operatorname{im} f)|_V)=0$, with module right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Form $c:L\mathcal H(US)\to\mathcal H(S)$ by the inverse exact-sheafification homology comparison $L\mathcal H(US)\to\mathcal H(LUS)$ followed by $\mathcal H(\epsilon_S)$. Then evaluation over $V$ of the adjoint $\mathcal H(US)\to U\mathcal H(S)$ of $c$ is an isomorphism of additive groups. No acyclicity of the three terms or the homology object, and no surrounding complex, is assumed.

proof.text: For any epimorphism f of module sheaves, restrict the short exact sequence kernel(f) -> source(f) -> target(f) to V. Restriction preserves finite limits by preservesLimitsOfSize_restrictFunctor and colimits by its left adjunction. Apply exists_rightDerived_full_long_exact to globalSectionsFunctor on V. If H^1(V,kernel(f)|V) is zero, the degree-zero connecting arrow is zero and exactness makes R^0 Gamma(f) epi. Conjugate by rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf and identify sections of the restriction over top with sections over V, obtaining epi of evaluation(f). This is the private proved helper epi_sections_of_h1_kernel_zero.

Set Z=S.cycles and a=S.toCycles. The kernel of factorThruImage(a) is canonically kernel(S.f), by kernelFactorThruImage, kernelCompMono and a ≫ S.iCycles = S.f. The kernel of S.homologyπ identifies with image(a), by exactness of a -> Z -> S.homology and the kernel universal property for its image inclusion; identify image(a) with image(S.f) by the strong epi-mono factorization factorThruImage(a) followed by image.ι(a) ≫ S.iCycles. Transport the given two H^1 vanishings through these isomorphisms and apply the preceding helper, yielding epimorphisms on sections of factorThruImage(a) and S.homologyπ.

For a left exact functor F preserving those two epimorphisms, the short complex image(a) -> Z -> S.homology stays exact since its first map is the kernel of S.homologyπ. Compare it to the section image of a -> Z -> S.homology by F(factorThruImage(a)), identity, identity; exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono transfers exactness. The epi F(S.homologyπ) therefore remains a cokernel of F(a). Together with preserved cycles this is preservation of left homology. Apply this to evaluation over V followed by exact forgetting of scalars. This argument is fully proved in preservesLeftHomologyOf_of_section_epis.

Let L be exact sheafification, U forget the sheaf condition, and P=S.map U. Let k:P.cycles -> U(S.cycles) be the canonical kernel comparison isomorphism. Calculate the adjunction-normalized arrow t:P.homology -> U(S.homology): P.homologyπ ≫ t = k ≫ U(S.homologyπ). To verify it, apply the inverse homEquiv, commute homologyπ with the inverse mapHomologyIso, and use homologyπ_naturality of the counit. Its cyclesMap composed with the inverse mapCyclesIso equals L(k) followed by counit on S.cycles, as seen after the monic cycles inclusion and counit naturality. The calculation proves adjoint_homology_comparison_cycles without hypotheses on cohomology.

Apply exact presheaf evaluation E to the calculation. Compare the two cycle isomorphisms after the monic section cycles inclusion: (P.mapCyclesIso E).hom ≫ E(k) = (S.mapCyclesIso (U ⋙ E)).hom. Precompose with the epimorphic section homologyπ and use the homologyπ formulas for mapHomologyIso. This gives (P.mapHomologyIso E).hom ≫ E(t) = (S.mapHomologyIso (U ⋙ E)).hom. Thus E(t) is explicitly the composite of the inverse first isomorphism with the second. It is an isomorphism and is definitionally the displayed arrow. No new lemma remains unproved and the unit route is unchanged.

mathlib_searches.query: For a short complex of sheaves, vanishing of first cohomology of the kernel and image of the incoming differential implies sections commute with homology
A left exact functor preserves homology of a short complex if the kernel and image of its first differential have vanishing first right derived functor

theorem shortComplex_sectionComparison_isIso
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (S : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf))
    (V : Y.Opens)
    (hkernel : IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace 1).obj
      ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (kernel S.f))))
    (himage : IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace 1).obj
      ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (image S.f)))) :
    IsIso (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map
      ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction.{u} (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)).homEquiv
        (S.map (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf)).homology S.homology
        (((S.map (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf)).mapHomologyIso
          (PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj))).inv ≫
          ShortComplex.homologyMap (S.mapNatTrans
            (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction.{u}
              (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)).counit)))).app (op V))
